kind: read-only STF and licensed validator source audit

sourceConfirmedFindings.finding: Specification places the stylesheet in util/style; root examples name ich-stf-stylesheet.xsl through an XML stylesheet PI. Current generator emits no PI and bundler stylesheet requirements do not condition on STFs.
sourceConfirmedFindings.minimalCorrection: Reuse existing bundler: add a named STF stylesheet constant and conditional requirement when STFs exist; compute its path relative to each STF, emit PI, retain existing checksum/presence gates. No official artifact may be invented.

sourceConfirmedFindings.finding: info-type must match ICH versus regional table classification. Generator unconditionally writes ich, including existing table-listed US roles.
sourceConfirmedFindings.minimalCorrection: Scope a mapping to exact source-observed values; preserve ICH CSR body/appendix roles and unknown-role advice. Modern SDTM/SEND/ADaM and legacy-suffixed names need current technical source before claiming their provenance.

sourceConfirmedFindings.finding: Spec requires new for first STF for a study in that CTD element and append thereafter to the most recently submitted STF, with modified-file reference; version cites STF version2.2. Current synthetic STF leaf is always new and leaf renderer emits no version attribute.
sourceConfirmedFindings.boundary: Packager currently has no prior-STF input in PackagerInput. Fix requires a trusted existing predecessor/manifest seam, not guessing from sequence number. A first STF can occur in a nonzero sequence.

sourceConfirmedFindings.finding: Controlled studies in5.3.5.1 are grouped by typed type-of-control category; current studyCategory string is intentionally warned and not emitted. Complete qualification needs the real typed study facts, without fabricating a control type.
sourceConfirmedFindings.boundary: Do not broaden a stylesheet/grammar correction into invented study metadata.

sourceConfirmedFindings.finding: US subject-profiles/case-report-forms should include property name=site-identifier with info-type=us and actual site text; current leaf interface supplies no property.
sourceConfirmedFindings.boundary: No site identity should be inferred from title or study id.

grammarUncertainty.docContentTitle: Current doc-content adds title. SectionIII p7 describes property and file-tag, and all examples omit doc-content/title; source supports a concern, but formal exclusivity/cardinality is not proven without the actual DTD. Do not call this agency DTD-qualified based on an authored synthetic DTD.
grammarUncertainty.rootLanguage: All official examples use xml:lang=en; no conclusion that it is required can be drawn from examples alone.

suggestedTestSeams: server/services/ectd/__tests__/stf-generator.test.ts: independent parsed prolog and knownUS-vsICH info-type assertions; paths from injected package location.
server/services/ectd/__tests__/dtd-bundler.test.ts: STFs conditionally require stylesheet; no STF keeps original requirement; report-only and required-production missing outcomes unchanged.

server/services/submission-gateways/__tests__/regional-packager-dtd-validation.test.ts: actual generated ZIP supportive path resolution, manifest coverage, required missing stylesheet refusal with synthetic labelled bytes only.

server/services/submission-gateways/__tests__/stf-packaging.test.ts and server/services/ectd/qualification/__tests__/qualification-stf.test.ts: actual STF bytes and independent prolog/path checks, not sole checks of production constants.

licensedValidator.notEstablishedByCurrentConfig: No engine or profile selector is present. No external validator invocation occurred; installed but unselected tools were not searched. External pass would still not be an FDA ACK or complete agency acceptance.

workPerformed: Read-only repository/source/selector-presence audit; factual JSON only. No tests, builds, compilers, code edits, DTD/XSL acquisitions, providers, external messages or agency submissions.
